state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Netflix in 5 sentences. Just tell me what normal people think about Netflix; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Some users express excitement about renewing their subscriptions to watch specific shows like The Walking Dead or movies such as Ed Gein. Several tweets describe relaxing at home in sweats while binge-watching content alone or with a partner. A few individuals complain that the service does not load, lacks certain titles like Super Troopers, or offers poor recommendations. Others mention sharing passwords with friends or family members to access their favorite series without paying extra fees. Some users also note that they prefer Netflix over traditional TV due to the absence of commercials and the ability to watch on multiple devices.
